```yaml
name: Secrets Diagnostics

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  secrets-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Go
      uses: actions/setup-go@v2
      with:
        go-version: '1.17'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: go mod download

    - name: Run secrets diagnostics
      run: |
        go test ./... -run TestSecretsDiagnostics
```

This workflow will run on every push and pull request to the `main` branch. It checks out the repository, sets up Go, installs dependencies, and then runs tests that specifically check for issues related to secret management and token fallback chains. The test function `TestSecretsDiagnostics` should be implemented in one of your Go files to verify that the token fallback chain is working as expected.
